raw_baseline.scope: Verified pre-change immutable baseline referenced directly; no redundant whole-snapshot copy

protocol.reference_description: Frozen phase009 generator/planner/workflow and sampler with identical final optimizer runtime, inspector, contracts and MR overlays; shared observations do not add phase010 goals or planner feedback to reference.
protocol.primary: Common optimizer-chain-1 observer with original source validity/mutation obligations: target Node -> completed backward -> registered parameter post-accumulate -> consumed gradient layout -> completed native SGD. Source chain cases/unique units and planned gradient-representation+update goal attainment remain separate from followup attainment.

pre_model_amendment.scope: Both reference and candidate development/final searches; all six locked targets are differentiable tensor APIs.
pre_model_amendment.reason: The endpoint requires attributable target backward and optimizer completion. Mixed attempt0 is forward-only and inherited parent obligations can consume the bounded campaign without exercising the endpoint.
pre_model_amendment.timing: Root must freeze this amendment in the protocol ledger before any model call; completed runtime-only validation remains separate.
pre_model_amendment.interpretation: A deliberately backward-required capability-study denominator; not broad API coverage or general mixed-path throughput superiority.

development_amendment.evidence: All four 90-second searches stopped after one fresh case on whole-round reserve; candidate sin had a verified reusable chain; add lacked source-effects admission for indexed initialization/loop/computed parameter collections.
candidate_changes: bounded library configuration candidates, with only actually selected goals consumed across proposal routes
same-parent completed-worker reserve for known configurations, unchanged factor1.5 plus5 floor10; quota first, unknown/general/repair retain whole-round reserve
generator communicates existing straight-line source-effects fragment; oracle domain unchanged
development_amendment.scope: Bundled system treatment; no isolated attribution. Final panel,seed0,time120 and symmetric oracle/runtime unchanged.

numerical_audit_scope.status_denominator: Saved source/followup member audit records, not unique programs or actual finite-difference executions. Unknown/not-selected entries remain distinguishable by reason.
numerical_audit_scope.tradeoff: The existing local numerical-gradient audit admits pure/local-VJP source certificates, not the separate optimizer-update certificate. Source-owned optimizer.step may therefore make a selected audit unsupported despite complete target Node evidence.
numerical_audit_scope.interpretation: Report this lost audit eligibility explicitly alongside optimizer MR applicability. Equal pre-update logical gradients plus equal post-update parameters/slots test gradient-representation consumption; they do not independently establish derivative correctness or confirm a framework defect.
numerical_audit_scope.policy: Keep existing numerical oracle routing and thresholds unchanged in both arms.

protocol.heldout_policy: Only sin/add are development search targets. mm/linear/tanh/bmm locked before final; existing code/unit use does not make APIs implementation-unseen. No outcome-dependent replacement or post-final tuning.
protocol.timing: Original detection timestamps preserved; exception reruns/automatic replay consume search wall budget. Metadata setup, controls/regression/fixtures, common raw-record scoring separate. Do not add overlapping cost components or call allocated GPU time utilization.
protocol.interpretation: One seed descriptive feasibility study, no statistical superiority/component causality or confirmed-defect claim. Zero parameter change remains valid; nonzero update is a secondary informative subset. Layout transformation occurs after target backward, not before accumulation. Both arms require backward on this differentiable panel; results do not measure broad mixed-path API exploration.

reference.scope: Supplied known triggers and controls, not autonomous discoveries

candidate.scope: Supplied known triggers and controls, not autonomous discoveries

definitions.source_valid: Original completed execution/API/inspection validity and mutation obligations.
definitions.planned_conjunction: A state_plan attempt requesting gradient representation and matching same-parameter completed-update companion; attainment additionally requires original source-valid chain and all predicates reached.
definitions.observed_count_partition: Unmeasured is not zero. Verified-zero/nonzero and unknown count partition all measured observer records; *_valid reports the valid subset.
definitions.numerical_audit: Auxiliary member-record statuses, including not-selected unknown; neither an independent defect confirmation nor number of finite-difference evaluations.
definitions.costs: Recorded overlapping components; no sum interpreted as wall time. Replay is charged to search; original finished timestamp remains detection/initial attempt time.
definitions.raw_hashes: Tensor hashes copied exactly from common-scorer input manifests; tensor files are not read or reverified by this stdlib reporter.
